question_bank.stem: In the DeconvNet reconstruction procedure, what is done after selecting one feature map and finding its maximum activation?

options.text: All other entries in that feature map are zeroed out
All feature maps are averaged into one scalar
All class labels are replaced with the selected class
All pooling switches are discarded before unpooling

question_bank.rationale: The instructor says to keep the maximum activation and zero out every other entry before reversing through the network.

distractor_rationales.B: Averaging feature maps describes global average pooling, not this DeconvNet step.
distractor_rationales.C: Labels are not modified during activation reconstruction.
distractor_rationales.D: Switches must be kept for unpooling, not discarded.

source_ref.evidence_span: We zero out every other entries of this matrix.

frame_evidence.description: Slide shows a selected feature map with its maximum activation kept and other entries zeroed before reversing through the network.

question_bank.stem: Why are max-pooling switches needed during DeconvNet unpooling?

options.text: They remember where the max value came from in the pooling window
They store which class had the largest softmax probability
They average every channel before the classifier head
They detect which benchmark examples were contaminated

question_bank.rationale: The lecture explains that max pooling is not invertible unless the forward pass remembers the max locations as switches.

distractor_rationales.B: Switches are spatial max locations, not class probabilities.
distractor_rationales.C: Channel averaging is a different CAM-related operation.
distractor_rationales.D: Benchmark contamination uses data comparisons, not pooling switches.

frame_evidence.description: Slide explains max-pooling switches as remembered max locations used for unpooling.

question_bank.stem: After reversing a selected deep activation through unpooling, ReLU handling, and deconvolution, what should the reconstruction represent?

options.text: The input-space region that caused the activation to be high
The final class probability after retraining the model
The global data-domain proportions in the corpus
The token-to-token relation learned by an attention head

question_bank.rationale: The DeconvNet reconstruction is meant to show the cropped input region or zone of influence for the activation.

distractor_rationales.B: The procedure visualizes an activation cause; it does not retrain the classifier.
distractor_rationales.C: Domain proportions are data diagnostics, not DeconvNet output.
distractor_rationales.D: Attention heads are transformer internals, not CNN deconvolution reconstructions.
